name: formfeed
description: Write and check Formfeed templates and the code that renders them, and render PDFs and images from your templates, from your coding agent. Signs in with your Formfeed account.

interface.longDescription: Write and check Formfeed templates and the code that renders them, and render PDFs and images from your templates, from your coding agent. Signs in with your Formfeed account. Two skills write, check and render templates with the formfeed command line and write the code that renders them through the API; the hosted MCP server lists your templates, checks data and renders.
defaultPrompt: Write an invoice template for this project and check it with formfeed validate
Render a PDF from my invoice template with this data
Add code that renders our order confirmation through the Formfeed API
